supported_findings: Straight-step and chirp probes passed every preregistered trajectory tolerance.
Positive and negative sustained-rudder probes failed yaw RMSE and final yaw limits; both narrowly failed final horizontal-position limits.
All thrust, rudder, yaw and ENU-to-NED direction checks passed.
The best scalar yaw-rate mapping left 0.137 relative RMSE, and the speed-normalized curvature mapping left 0.108 relative RMSE, against a diagnostic 0.05 scalar-multiple threshold.
The disagreement is angle/speed dependent and is not explained by a single LiftDrag gain change.

mechanism_hypothesis.bcod_sim: MMG rudder force includes propeller-race inflow and hull/rudder interaction through wake and interaction terms including gamma_R, a_H and x_H.
mechanism_hypothesis.gazebo: Stock LiftDrag treats the rudder as a foil in its local freestream and does not implement the MMG propeller-race and hull-interaction formulation.
mechanism_hypothesis.interpretation: Those omitted mechanisms are consistent with the observed angle/speed dependence, but this diagnostic does not uniquely attribute the residual to them.

corroboration: The result independently localizes the weak agreement to rudder/yaw response, consistent with the existing held-out MARIN zig-zag transient failures. This is corroboration of a scoped weakness, not an additional validation pass.
excluded_actions: No custom MMG Gazebo plugin was introduced.
No LiftDrag coefficient was fitted to bcod-sim output.
